title: Claude Code v2.1.80 — MCP Push Channels, Rate Limits Statusline, Settings Plugins, Effort for Skills
description: Claude Code v2.1.80 (released March 19, 2026) introduces four integrable features: (1) --channels flag (research preview) for MCP servers to push messages to Claude sessions — MCP servers can now initiate communication rather than only responding to tool calls. Enables event-driven MCP patterns: push notifications, live data subscriptions, background task completion signals; (2) rate_limits field in statusline scripts — exposes 5-hour and 7-day Claude.ai rate limit usage. Format: {rate_limits: {hour5: {used: N, limit: N}, day7: {used: N, limit: N}}}. Critical for heartbeat scripts to back off when approaching limits; (3) source: 'settings' plugin marketplace source — inline plugin declarations directly in settings.json without using the marketplace UI. Format: {plugins: [{source: 'settings', ...}]}. Enables version-controlled plugin configuration; (4) effort frontmatter for skills and slash commands — extends the v2.1.78 effort frontmatter (previously agents-only) to skills and slash commands. Add 'effort: low|medium|high|max' to skill frontmatter to control compute allocation. Additional improvements: ~80 MB memory reduction on startup in large repos, improved @ file autocomplete in large repos, fixed --resume dropping parallel tool results, fixed voice mode WebSocket failures.

redundancy_check.notes: MCP --channels: No existing bidirectional MCP capability in registry. All MCP interactions are currently request-response (Claude calls tools). Push messaging is architecturally new. rate_limits statusline: No existing rate limit monitoring in statusline. helpers/navigation/hook-environment-variables.md covers env vars but not rate limit fields. source:settings plugins: No existing inline plugin config pattern. effort for skills: IMPROVEMENT — v2.1.78 added effort to agents. This extends the same pattern to skills and slash commands. Bundle is NOVEL overall.

evaluation.reasoning: Four integrable features with genuinely novel capabilities. Star feature: MCP --channels push messaging changes the MCP communication model from request-response to bidirectional. Currently research preview but architecturally significant — enables event-driven MCP patterns for heartbeat automation (push task completion, rate limit alerts, live data feeds). Integration path: add --channels flag to any MCP server that benefits from push; no immediate action needed until stable. rate_limits statusline is immediately useful: update heartbeat statusline script to surface 5h/7d usage for adaptive rate limiting in cron runs. source:settings plugins enables version-controlled plugin config — update settings.json to use inline declarations for any currently marketplace-installed plugins. effort for skills is a low-friction improvement: add 'effort: low' to discovery/routing skills to reduce token cost. Integration complexity reduced (research preview --channels deferred; three other features are settings.json/frontmatter changes). Bundle scores 81.25/100 — approve and update registry.
